byPath.*: Calculates the annual leave of every employee from age and years of service, with a pro rata share for part-time employees and new hires and a capped carry-over
byPath.Employee: One employee: birth date, hire date, contract, FTE, carried-over days and taken days
byPath.EmployeeFacts: The terms of the policy for one employee: age, years of service, months in service and working time
byPath.LeaveBalance: The carry-over within the cap, the forfeited days, the available days and the remaining days
byPath.LeaveEntitlement: The vacation days of the employee, pro rata for part-time work and for months in service, rounded up to half days
byPath.LeaveYear: The leave year: the calculation date and the employees
byPath.Profile: An age and a number of service years, to look up in the vacation days table
byPath.benchmarkBook: The seven cases of the vacation days benchmark
byPath.benchmarkBook.days: The vacation days of each benchmark case
byPath.benchmarkBook.profiles: The ages and the service years of the benchmark
byPath.extraDays: The vacation days table: every matching rule adds extra days to the base days
byPath.halfDaysUp: Rounds a number of days up to the next half day
byPath.leaveEntitlements: The entitlement and the balance of every employee of the leave year, and a team summary
byPath.leavePolicy: The parameters of the leave policy: the base days and the carry-over cap
byPath.teamBook: The leave of a team of six employees in 2026
byPath.teamBook.entitlements: The entitlement and the balance of every employee
byPath.teamBook.leaveYear: The calculation date and the employees
byPath.vacationDays: The base days plus the extra days of every matching rule
byPath.vacationDaysTable: The vacation days of each profile
